public_rationale: In November 2024, Reuters reported that labs were seeking new methods. Ilya Sutskever told Reuters that results from scaling up pre-training had plateaued. On December 4, 2024, Pichai said the low-hanging fruit was gone and that 'deeper breakthroughs' were needed. Nadella's Ignite keynote acknowledged the debate over whether scaling had 'hit the wall,' called scaling laws empirical rather than physical laws, and said skepticism would spur innovation in architectures. But he also pointed to a new test-time scaling law. So his part fits Marcus's description only loosely. Altman disputed any wall. Even so, the hedged core claim (by most accounts, scaling returns were diminishing and breakthroughs were needed) matches prominent reporting at the time.
limitations: Nadella's remarks are ambiguous and can be read as optimistic about scaling.
Later scaling progress after December 2024 is outside the period and not considered.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: By most accounts, returns from scaling have begun to diminish and new breakthroughs are needed.

statement.excerpt: In 2022 I warned that scaling would not hold, and that we would need alternative approaches; by most accounts, scaling has begun to diminish, and Nadella and Pichai both affirmed the need for new breakthroughs.

from_speaker: Nadella and Pichai both affirmed the need for new breakthroughs
our_interpretation: Plain reading: by the post date (December 11, 2024), mainstream reporting and leading figures widely said that gains from scaling up pre-training were slowing.
Second part: the Google CEO (Pichai) and the Microsoft CEO (Nadella) publicly said that more than plain scaling, such as new breakthroughs or new approaches, was needed.
Period: November 1 to December 11, 2024, when the cited remarks and reports appeared.
The earlier 2022 warning is background. It is not separately scored.
criteria.support_condition: Prominent late-2024 reports or experts saying pre-training scaling was showing diminishing returns, plus statements by Pichai and Nadella that new breakthroughs or approaches were needed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The dominant view in late 2024 was that scaling returns were not slowing, or Pichai and Nadella made no such statements.

evidence.explanation: Pichai said in early December 2024 that progress is getting harder and deeper breakthroughs are needed. This matches the Pichai part of the claim.

evidence.excerpt: Ilya Sutskever, co-founder of AI labs Safe Superintelligence (SSI) and OpenAI, told Reuters recently that results from scaling up pre-training - the phase of training an AI model that use s a vast amount of unlabeled data to understand language patterns and structures - have plateaued.
evidence.explanation: Major reporting in November 2024 said the results of pre-training scaling had plateaued and that labs were looking for new methods. This supports 'by most accounts, scaling has begun to diminish.'
